title: 파리의 거리, 비 오는 날
caption: The image is a painting of a street scene in Paris, France. It shows a group of people walking on a cobblestone street, holding umbrellas to protect themselves from the rain. The street is lined with buildings on both sides, and there is a street lamp on the right side of the image. In the center of the painting, there are two men and a woman walking side by side, both dressed in formal attire. The man on the left is wearing a black suit and a top hat, while the man in the middle is holding a large umbrella. The woman on the far right is also holding a smaller umbrella. There is a horse-drawn carriage on the street, and a few other people can be seen in the background. The sky is overcast, and the overall mood of the scene is gloomy and rainy.
